show.description: When visionary executive Ravi Kashyap is betrayed by his corrupt CEO Nakul Shastry and abandoned by his wife Shanaya Kashyap, his world collapses. But a chance encounter with delivery boy Chandra Gowda reignites his fire. Guided by the ancient wisdom of Chanakya Neeti, Ravi transforms himself into a modern day Chanakya building an empire from ashes to take ruthless revenge on those who destroyed him.
